Analogy for Chronostructure: Imagine a stationary record player where the music (matter/motion) is only revealed when the needle (the time surface) sweeps across the grooves (the filaments). The "core equation" is the angle of the needle; if the groove is straight, the note is steady (rest), but if the groove is curved, the note slides (acceleration). The fine-structure constant is simply the width of the needle's tip—if the groove is too wide or too narrow compared to that tip, the music fails to couple and you hear only silence
